struck: Care at home from a home health aide costs about $31 an hour.
use: A non-medical caregiver at home, such as a home health aide or a homemaker, costs about $31 an hour; the survey's $5,911 a month assumes 44 hours a week.

struck: In all, 23 homes and 1,860 beds in these Grand Strand towns.
use: In all, 23 homes and 1,860 beds in Horry County and the Georgetown County side of Murrells Inlet and Pawleys Island.

struck: North Myrtle Beach has no licensed assisted living inside its own mailing city; the nearest homes are in Little River.
use: No licensed assisted living home has a North Myrtle Beach address; three sit within a mile of its city limits, one in Little River and two in Myrtle Beach.

struck: When needs pass what the home can give, the person must move within 30 days.
use: When the home's care, even with outside home health or hospice care, no longer meets a person's needs, the person must move within 30 days.

struck: Every licensed assisted living home keeps a written disaster and evacuation plan made with the county emergency agency, reviewed yearly; residents and families may ask to see it.
use: Every licensed assisted living home keeps a written disaster and evacuation plan made with the county emergency agency and updated yearly; a resident or the resident's responsible party may ask to see it.

struck: South Carolina licenses 34 continuing care retirement communities.
use: South Carolina licenses 33 continuing care retirement communities.

pattern: \bIt pays an entrance fee|communit(?:y|ies) pays?[^.]{0,30}entrance fee
struck: It pays an entrance fee to hold the place.
use: The resident pays an entrance fee, which holds the resident's place.

struck: A continuing care retirement community gives, under one contract, a home (an apartment or a cottage) and care that grows with a person's needs.
use: A continuing care retirement community offers, under one contract, an apartment or a cottage and access to a range of long-term care as a resident's needs change.

struck: The resident may cancel within 30 days of signing and gets back what was paid, less the community's costs.
use: The resident may cancel within 30 days of signing and gets back what was paid, less the community's costs and, if the home was ready to move into, a daily charge from the eighth day.

struck: Before signing, a continuing care community must give a disclosure statement.
use: By the time the contract is signed or any money is paid, whichever comes first, the community must give a disclosure statement.

struck: South Carolina's Optional State Supplementation (OSS) helps people 65 or older, blind or disabled, with low income, pay for a licensed assisted living home that takes part.
use: South Carolina's Optional State Supplementation (OSS) helps people 65 or older, blind or disabled, with income and savings under its limits, live in a licensed assisted living home enrolled in OSS, with an approved OSS slot.

struck: HUD lists four HUD-assisted apartment buildings for older adults in Horry County, 228 apartments in all.
use: HUD lists four assisted apartment buildings in its elderly group in Horry County, 228 apartments in all; one, with 110 apartments, is partly for people with disabilities.

struck: Licensed assisted living beds in Horry County, about 13 per 1,000 people 65 or older.
use: (cut it: the beds serve adults of any age, so the ratio mixes two groups)

struck: Surfside Beach lends special beach wheelchairs through its police.
use: Special beach wheelchairs are available through the Surfside Beach Police Department.
